lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region. The central row shows a roughly equidistant spacing of approximately 50-70 pixels between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of spots to form a non-orthogonal grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the most prominent ridge exhibits a sharp luminance gradient transition approximately 30% down the visible flank, extending from the posterior gill slits towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 5-8 small, low-contrast spots localized primarily along the posterior margin and basal region of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Primary anomaly is a significant irregular notch or indentation on the posterior-superior margin of the first dorsal fin. Secondary linear vertical abrasion visible on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of approximately 12-15 spots localized on the anterior-distal surface.
